items.why: Two fleets on one key still fight for it, and a bare 429 ends a codex turn at once. Only the lender can pace or absorb that.
A throttle delivered inside a 200 stream reads as a success in the lender's log, so a fleet at its limit still looks healthy.
An intermittent stall reds main CI, and nothing yet says whether the guest or its ssh died.
A stale pid file can send SIGKILL to another of your processes after a host reboot.
Creating a sandbox silently changes the permissions of files in the directory you shared.
A store holding real images needs twice its size in host memory to build a microVM disk.
Past fourteen shares a microVM drops one and still reports success.
